public class AuditOwnerCreated {

    public void service(@Val Owner owner, @Val OwnerDto dto) {
        AUDIT.info("owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={} "
                + "membershipNumber={}",

                dto.getMembershipLevel(), dto.getMembershipNumber());

}

save:      SaveOwner        -> recordKey
recordKey: RecordIdempotencyKey -> mapOwner

- Run commands (from `readme.md`): `./mvnw spring-boot:run` to run the app; `mvn clean install` for a full build.
